Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent game toolbar sprite sheet.
Input image: style reference only, the existing main toolbar painted icon sheet.
Create a NEW matching family of map toolbar icons: smooth hand-painted miniature objects, dimensional materials, highlights from upper left, restrained contours, saturated readable color accents, crisp anti-aliased silhouettes. Match the reference's painted metal, stone, foliage and architectural miniatures. No pixel art, no flat vector pictograms, no heavy black outlines.
Layout: EXACT regular 4 columns by 3 rows on a square 1536x1536 transparent canvas. Each icon centered inside its own equal square cell, generous 12 percent transparent padding on every cell edge. Absolutely no touching or crossing into adjacent cells. No labels, text, grid, frames, backplates or drop shadows outside the objects.
Subjects in exact reading order:
Row 1: (1) cluster of three colorful city buildings on an isometric paved lot; (2) short asphalt road segment with white dashed center line, on a narrow stone base; (3) a vivid red enamel lightning bolt with metallic edge; (4) polished silver water faucet with one large blue water drop.
Row 2: (5) group of three people, varied blue green amber clothing, cropped busts; (6) a steel police shield with gold star; (7) industrial brick smokestacks emitting a compact dark gray smoke plume; (8) green money bag with gold coin in front, no currency letters.
Row 3: (9) neoclassical civic building with stone columns and terracotta roof; (10) small isometric zoning lot divided into green residential, blue commercial, golden industrial tiles; (11) short railway segment with brown sleepers and steel rails; (12) short road with three small red amber green cars to represent traffic.
Transparent background with real alpha. Original designs. These icons must be legible when reduced to 32 pixels. Each cell one complete distinct centered icon.
